title: "Week 05: Visualization for papers"
format: html

This source file records the slide design contract for the public deck in
`slides.html`. The HTML file is maintained directly because it uses the shared
bilingual slide runtime, slide overview modal, page-number jump control, and
final CTA links for GitHub Pages.

## Slide Sequence

1. Hero: cleaned data to Results figure.
2. Week 04 bridge: clean data before figure.
3. Research question and descriptive claim boundary.
4. Data preview with raw and usable N.
5. Chart choice: bar, dots, caption, claim.
6. Filter to `usable_pre_post`.
7. Summary table for figure checks.
8. Barplot code and labeling.
9. Dotplot code and small-N warning.
10. Color with purpose.
11. Export with `savefig`, PNG/SVG.
12. Caption frame.
13. Interpretation frame with limitation.
14. Assignment checklist.
15. Final CTA.
